{
  "plan": "# Temperature Bot - Senior Developer Onboarding Report\n\n## Executive Summary\n\n**Temperature Bot** is an automated HVAC control system for BasisTech LLC that monitors temperature sensors and air quality, then dynamically controls Energy Recovery Ventilators (ERVs) based on configurable Python rules. The system collects data from Hubitat IoT devices and AE-200 HVAC controllers, stores time-series data in SQLite with run-length encoding, and provides a Flask web dashboard for monitoring and manual control.\n\n## Project Overview\n\n### Purpose\nAutomate HVAC control for energy efficiency and air quality management by:\n- Collecting temperature data from multiple sensors every minute\n- Monitoring outdoor Air Quality Index (AQI) from aqicn.org\n- Executing time-based and air-quality-based rules to control ERV fan speeds\n- Providing a web interface for monitoring and manual override\n- Maintaining historical data for analysis\n\n### Tech Stack\n- **Backend**: Python 3.12+, Flask web framework\n- **Database**: SQLite3 with run-length encoding for temperature data compression\n- **Hardware Integration**: \n  - Hubitat IoT platform (temperature sensors)\n  - AE-200 HVAC controllers via WebSocket\n- **Deployment**: Gunicorn with systemd on Ubuntu\n- **Testing**: pytest with Playwright for browser automation\n- **Development Tools**: Poetry, Ruff, pylint, mypy, djlint\n\n## Architecture\n\n### System Components\n\n1. **Flask Web Application** (&#96;app/main.py&#96;)\n   - Serves web dashboard and REST API\n   - Modular route structure (API in &#96;routes_api.py&#96;, web in &#96;routes_web.py&#96;)\n   - Runs on port 8100 behind reverse proxy\n\n2. **Periodic Runner** (&#96;bin/runner.py&#96;)\n   - Runs every minute via cron/systemd timer\n   - Collects temperature data from Hubitat and AE-200\n   - Updates AQI data\n   - Executes automation rules\n   - Performs daily data cleanup/coarsening\n\n3. **Rules Engine** (&#96;bin/rules.py&#96; + &#96;app/rules_engine.py&#96;)\n   - Python-based rules file that gets &#96;exec()&#96;ed\n   - Access to device IDs, time variables, AQI\n   - Can disable rules per-device or globally for specified duration\n   - Rules automatically disabled for 3 hours after manual control\n\n### Key Design Patterns\n\n**Run-Length Encoding for Temperature Data**\n- Instead of inserting a new row every minute, extends the &#96;duration&#96; field if temperature and status unchanged\n- Dramatically reduces database size\n- Max duration: 1 hour before forcing new entry\n- Implementation: &#96;db.py::insert_devlog_entry()&#96;\n\n**Simulator Pattern**\n- AE-200 controller can run in simulator mode via &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR&#96; env var\n- Loads test data from &#96;app/test_data/ae200_*.json&#96;\n- Enables development without hardware access\n- Critical for CI/CD and local testing\n\n**Async/Sync Hybrid**\n- AE-200 uses WebSockets (async), but wrapped with &#96;AsyncRunner&#96; for sync contexts\n- &#96;runner.run_async_safely()&#96; handles both event loop and non-event-loop contexts\n\n## Database Schema\n\n**4 Main Tables** (&#96;etc/schema.sql&#96;):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ndevices          # Device registry with name, AE200 mapping, rules disable state\n  device_id (PK), device_name, ae200_device_id, disabled_until, notes\n\ndevlog           # Temperature/status log with run-length encoding\n  log_id (PK), device_id (FK), logtime, duration, temp10x, status_json\n\nchangelog        # Audit log of all control changes\n  changelog_id (PK), logtime, device_id (FK), unit, ipaddr, \n  current_values, new_value, agent, comment\n\naqi              # Air quality index time series\n  logtime, aqi, co, h, no2, o3, p, pm10, pm25, so2, t, w\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Key Design Notes**:\n- Temperature stored as &#96;temp10x&#96; (Celsius * 10) for integer precision\n- &#96;status_json&#96; stores full device state as JSON blob\n- &#96;disabled_until&#96; is Unix timestamp; 0 = enabled\n- AQI table stores full IAQI breakdown from aqicn.org\n\n## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ntemperature-bot/\n├── app/                      # Main application package\n│   ├── main.py              # Flask app factory\n│   ├── db.py                # Database operations (600+ lines)\n│   ├── rules_engine.py      # Rules execution logic\n│   ├── routes_api.py        # REST API endpoints (/api/v1/*)\n│   ├── routes_web.py        # Web page routes\n│   ├── ae200.py             # AE-200 controller interface\n│   ├── hubitat.py           # Hubitat IoT integration\n│   ├── airquality.py        # AQI data from multiple sources\n│   ├── weather.py           # US National Weather Service API\n│   ├── templates/           # Jinja2 HTML templates\n│   ├── static/              # JavaScript, CSS, echarts library\n│   └── utils/               # Helper modules\n├── bin/\n│   ├── runner.py            # Main periodic data collector\n│   ├── rules.py             # Business logic rules (exec'd)\n│   └── scheduler.py         # Device monitoring tool\n├── etc/\n│   ├── schema.sql           # Database schema\n│   ├── *.service            # Systemd unit files\n│   └── data/                # Sample JSON payloads\n├── tests/                   # Comprehensive pytest suite (54+ tests)\n│   ├── test_*.py           # Test modules\n│   └── helpers/            # Test utilities\n├── pyproject.toml          # Poetry dependencies\n└── Makefile               # Development tasks\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Key Files to Understand\n\n### Core Application\n- &#96;app/main.py&#96; - Entry point, Flask app creation\n- &#96;app/db.py&#96; - All database logic, **critical for understanding data flow**\n- &#96;app/rules_engine.py&#96; - How rules execute and disable mechanisms\n- &#96;bin/runner.py&#96; - Periodic job orchestration\n- &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; - **The actual business logic rules**\n\n### Hardware Interfaces\n- &#96;app/ae200.py&#96; - WebSocket communication with HVAC controllers\n- &#96;app/hubitat.py&#96; - REST API calls to Hubitat hub\n\n### Configuration\n- Configuration via YAML file (location: &#96;TEMPERATURE_BOT_CONFIG&#96; env var or &#96;temperature-bot-config.yaml&#96;)\n- Secrets stored in YAML or environment variables (env var takes precedence)\n- See &#96;app/util.py::get_config()&#96; and &#96;get_secret()&#96;\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n### REST API (&#96;/api/v1/*&#96;)\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/status&#96; - Current device status\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/temperature?device_ids=1,2&amp;start=&lt;unix&gt;&amp;end=&lt;unix&gt;&#96; - Time series data\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/air_quality&#96; - AQI time series\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/weather&#96; - Current weather + AQI\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/logs&#96; - Changelog with pagination\n- &#96;POST /api/v1/set_fan_speed&#96; - Control fan (JSON body: &#96;{device_id, fan_speed}&#96;)\n- &#96;POST /api/v1/set_drive&#96; - Control drive (JSON body: &#96;{device_id, drive}&#96;)\n- &#96;GET /api/v1/disable-rules?seconds=&lt;int&gt;&#96; - Disable all rules\n\n### Web Pages\n- &#96;/&#96; - Main dashboard with current status\n- &#96;/chart&#96; - Temperature/AQI charting (ECharts)\n- &#96;/rules&#96; - View rules, test execution, disable controls\n- &#96;/logs&#96; - Change history\n- &#96;/device_log/&lt;id&gt;&#96; - Per-device detailed log\n\n## Development Setup\n\n### Prerequisites\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# macOS\nmake install-macos\n\n# Ubuntu\nmake install-ubuntu\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis installs: pipx, poetry, ruff, and Playwright browsers.\n\n### Local Development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\npoetry install\n\n# Run with live reload and simulator\nmake local-dev\n# or manually:\nFLASK_DEBUG=True DB_PATH=var/db/temperature-bot.db AE200_SIMULATOR=1 python run_local.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Testing\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Run full test suite with coverage\nmake pytest\n\n# Run specific test file\npoetry run pytest tests/test_db.py -v\n\n# Linting\nmake pylint    # Python\nmake djlint    # HTML templates\nmake eslint    # JavaScript\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Database Management\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Fetch production database (readonly operations)\nmake fetch-dev-db\n\n# Recreate dev database from schema\nmake make-dev-db\n\n# Extract schema from database\nmake etc/schema.sql\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Testing Philosophy\n\n**Comprehensive Coverage** (54+ tests across 15 files):\n- Unit tests for core modules (&#96;test_db.py&#96;, &#96;test_ae200.py&#96;)\n- Integration tests (&#96;test_endpoints.py&#96;, &#96;test_routes.py&#96;)\n- Browser automation tests (&#96;test_browser_ux.py&#96; with Playwright)\n- Bin tools regression tests (&#96;test_bin_tools.py&#96;)\n\n**Key Testing Features**:\n- Simulator mode for hardware-independent tests\n- Temporary SQLite databases per test\n- Pytest fixtures for database states\n- GitHub Actions CI/CD compatible\n\n**Project-Specific Rules** (from &#96;.cursorrules&#96;):\n- Function-style pytest tests only (no base classes)\n- No f-strings in logging methods\n- Local fixtures preferred over conftest.py dependencies\n\n## Deployment\n\n**Production Environment**:\n- Ubuntu server with systemd\n- Service: &#96;air_basistech_net.service&#96;\n- Gunicorn with auto-worker scaling\n- Database: &#96;/var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;\n- Runs behind nginx reverse proxy\n\n**Cron Job** (every minute):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n*/1 * * * * /path/to/.venv/bin/python -m bin.runner\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Rules Engine Deep Dive\n\n**How Rules Work**:\n1. &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; is plain Python with special globals injected\n2. Available variables: device IDs (e.g., &#96;ERV_KITCHEN&#96;), time vars (&#96;HOUR&#96;, &#96;TUESDAY&#96;), &#96;AQI&#96;\n3. Available functions: &#96;set_drive(device_id, 0|1)&#96;, &#96;set_fan_speed(device_id, 1-4)&#96;\n4. Rules file is &#96;exec()&#96;ed with controlled namespace\n5. Before executing commands, checks if device/global rules disabled\n\n**Example Rule**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n# Tuesday/Thursday lunch rush - high ventilation\nif TUESDAY or THURSDAY:\n    if HOUR in [11, 12]:\n        kitchen_erv_speed = 4\n\n# Poor outdoor air - reduce fresh air intake\nif AQI &gt; 100:\n    kitchen_erv_speed = 0\n    set_drive(ERV_KITCHEN, 0)  # Turn off\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Testing Rules**:\n- &#96;/rules&#96; page shows rule preview for next 7 days across AQI thresholds\n- &#96;runner.py --rules test&#96; - Test rules without execution\n- &#96;rules_engine.rules_results()&#96; - Dry-run function\n\n## Common Tasks\n\n### Adding a New Device\n1. Add device to Hubitat or AE-200 controller\n2. Device auto-registers on first data collection\n3. Update &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; if automation needed\n4. Device ID constant appears in rules engine context\n\n### Modifying Rules\n1. Edit &#96;bin/rules.py&#96;\n2. Test with &#96;/rules&#96; page or &#96;runner.py --rules test&#96;\n3. Deploy (no app restart needed - rules re-read each execution)\n\n### Investigating Issues\n1. Check logs: systemd journal or syslog\n2. Database query: &#96;sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;\n3. Web interface &#96;/logs&#96; for change history\n4. Per-device log: &#96;/device_log/&lt;device_id&gt;&#96;\n\n### Adding API Endpoint\n1. Add route to &#96;routes_api.py&#96; or &#96;routes_web.py&#96;\n2. Use &#96;@with_db_connection&#96; decorator for automatic DB connection\n3. Use Pydantic models for request validation (&#96;flask_pydantic&#96;)\n4. Add corresponding test in &#96;tests/test_endpoints.py&#96;\n\n## Important Gotchas\n\n1. **Temperature stored as integers**: &#96;temp10x&#96; is Celsius * 10\n2. **Run-length encoding**: Queries must account for &#96;logtime + duration&#96;\n3. **Rules disable mechanism**: Manual control disables rules for 3 hours (&#96;RULES_DISABLE_SECONDS&#96;)\n4. **Simulator mode**: Always check &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR&#96; env var for tests\n5. **Async wrappers**: AE-200 uses async, wrapped for sync contexts\n6. **Config precedence**: Environment variables override YAML config\n7. **No pytest classes**: Project uses function-style tests only\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n- Secrets via environment variables or config YAML (not committed)\n- No authentication on web interface (internal network only)\n- SQL injection protected (parameterized queries throughout)\n- Rules engine uses controlled &#96;exec()&#96; namespace (no file system access)\n\n## Performance Characteristics\n\n- Database size: Run-length encoding keeps it manageable (months of data in MB)\n- Runner execution: ~2-5 seconds per cycle\n- API response times: &lt;100ms for most endpoints\n- Chart queries: Temporal quantification for large date ranges\n\n## Future Considerations\n\n- AQI storage in database (mentioned in TODO.md)\n- Potential migration from SQLite to TimescaleDB for better time-series performance\n- OAuth/authentication for web interface\n- Mobile app or notifications\n- Weather data correlation with temperature patterns\n\n## Resources\n\n- AE-200 Documentation: &#96;doc/AE-200.pdf&#96;\n- Airthings API: &#96;doc/airthings.md&#96;\n- Release Notes: &#96;doc/RELEASE_NOTES.md&#96;\n- Bin Tools Testing: &#96;tests/README_bin_tools.md&#96;\n- Sample data: &#96;etc/data/*.json&#96;, &#96;app/test_data/*.json&#96;\n\n## Getting Help\n\n- Codebase uses type hints extensively (mypy checked)\n- Docstrings on most functions\n- Test files serve as usage examples\n- Inline comments for complex logic (especially in &#96;db.py&#96; - 
+ # Temperature Bot - Senior Developer Onboarding Report
+ 
+ ## Executive Summary
+ 
+ **Temperature Bot** is an automated HVAC control system for BasisTech LLC that monitors temperature sensors and air quality, then dynamically controls Energy Recovery Ventilators (ERVs) based on configurable Python rules. The system collects data from Hubitat IoT devices and AE-200 HVAC controllers, stores time-series data in SQLite with run-length encoding, and provides a Flask web dashboard for monitoring and manual control.
+ 
+ ## Project Overview
+ 
+ ### Purpose
+ 
+ Automate HVAC control for energy efficiency and air quality management by:
+ 
+ - Collecting temperature data from multiple sensors every minute
+ - Monitoring outdoor Air Quality Index (AQI) from aqicn.org
+ - Executing time-based and air-quality-based rules to control ERV fan speeds
+ - Providing a web interface for monitoring and manual override
+ - Maintaining historical data for analysis
+ 
+ ### Tech Stack
+ 
+ - **Backend**: Python 3.12+, Flask web framework
+ - **Database**: SQLite3 with run-length encoding for temperature data compression
+ - **Hardware Integration**: 
+   - Hubitat IoT platform (temperature sensors)
+   - AE-200 HVAC controllers via WebSocket
+ - **Deployment**: Gunicorn with systemd on Ubuntu
+ - **Testing**: pytest with Playwright for browser automation
+ - **Development Tools**: Poetry, Ruff, pylint, mypy, djlint
+ 
+ ## Architecture
+ 
+ ### System Components
+ 
+ 1. **Flask Web Application** (&#96;app/main.py&#96;)
+ 
+    - Serves web dashboard and REST API
+    - Modular route structure (API in &#96;routes_api.py&#96;, web in &#96;routes_web.py&#96;)
+    - Runs on port 8100 behind reverse proxy
+ 
+ 2. **Periodic Runner** (&#96;bin/runner.py&#96;)
+ 
+    - Runs every minute via cron/systemd timer
+    - Collects temperature data from Hubitat and AE-200
+    - Updates AQI data
+    - Executes automation rules
+    - Performs daily data cleanup/coarsening
+ 
+ 3. **Rules Engine** (&#96;bin/rules.py&#96; + &#96;app/rules_engine.py&#96;)
+ 
+    - Python-based rules file that gets &#96;exec()&#96;ed
+    - Access to device IDs, time variables, AQI
+    - Can disable rules per-device or globally for specified duration
+    - Rules automatically disabled for 3 hours after manual control
+ 
+ ### Key Design Patterns
+ 
+ **Run-Length Encoding for Temperature Data**
+ 
+ - Instead of inserting a new row every minute, extends the &#96;duration&#96; field if temperature and status unchanged
+ - Dramatically reduces database size
+ - Max duration: 1 hour before forcing new entry
+ - Implementation: &#96;db.py::insert_devlog_entry()&#96;
+ 
+ **Simulator Pattern**
+ 
+ - AE-200 controller can run in simulator mode via &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR&#96; env var
+ - Loads test data from &#96;app/test_data/ae200_*.json&#96;
+ - Enables development without hardware access
+ - Critical for CI/CD and local testing
+ 
+ **Async/Sync Hybrid**
+ 
+ - AE-200 uses WebSockets (async), but wrapped with &#96;AsyncRunner&#96; for sync contexts
+ - &#96;runner.run_async_safely()&#96; handles both event loop and non-event-loop contexts
+ 
+ ## Database Schema
+ 
+ **4 Main Tables** (&#96;etc/schema.sql&#96;):
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ devices          # Device registry with name, AE200 mapping, rules disable state
+   device_id (PK), device_name, ae200_device_id, disabled_until, notes
+ 
+ devlog           # Temperature/status log with run-length encoding
+   log_id (PK), device_id (FK), logtime, duration, temp10x, status_json
+ 
+ changelog        # Audit log of all control changes
+   changelog_id (PK), logtime, device_id (FK), unit, ipaddr, 
+   current_values, new_value, agent, comment
+ 
+ aqi              # Air quality index time series
+   logtime, aqi, co, h, no2, o3, p, pm10, pm25, so2, t, w
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Key Design Notes**:
+ 
+ - Temperature stored as &#96;temp10x&#96; (Celsius * 10) for integer precision
+ - &#96;status_json&#96; stores full device state as JSON blob
+ - &#96;disabled_until&#96; is Unix timestamp; 0 = enabled
+ - AQI table stores full IAQI breakdown from aqicn.org
+ 
+ ## Project Structure
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ temperature-bot/
+ ├── app/                      # Main application package
+ │   ├── main.py              # Flask app factory
+ │   ├── db.py                # Database operations (600+ lines)
+ │   ├── rules_engine.py      # Rules execution logic
+ │   ├── routes_api.py        # REST API endpoints (/api/v1/*)
+ │   ├── routes_web.py        # Web page routes
+ │   ├── ae200.py             # AE-200 controller interface
+ │   ├── hubitat.py           # Hubitat IoT integration
+ │   ├── airquality.py        # AQI data from multiple sources
+ │   ├── weather.py           # US National Weather Service API
+ │   ├── templates/           # Jinja2 HTML templates
+ │   ├── static/              # JavaScript, CSS, echarts library
+ │   └── utils/               # Helper modules
+ ├── bin/
+ │   ├── runner.py            # Main periodic data collector
+ │   ├── rules.py             # Business logic rules (exec'd)
+ │   └── scheduler.py         # Device monitoring tool
+ ├── etc/
+ │   ├── schema.sql           # Database schema
+ │   ├── *.service            # Systemd unit files
+ │   └── data/                # Sample JSON payloads
+ ├── tests/                   # Comprehensive pytest suite (54+ tests)
+ │   ├── test_*.py           # Test modules
+ │   └── helpers/            # Test utilities
+ ├── pyproject.toml          # Poetry dependencies
+ └── Makefile               # Development tasks
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Key Files to Understand
+ 
+ ### Core Application
+ 
+ - &#96;app/main.py&#96; - Entry point, Flask app creation
+ - &#96;app/db.py&#96; - All database logic, **critical for understanding data flow**
+ - &#96;app/rules_engine.py&#96; - How rules execute and disable mechanisms
+ - &#96;bin/runner.py&#96; - Periodic job orchestration
+ - &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; - **The actual business logic rules**
+ 
+ ### Hardware Interfaces
+ 
+ - &#96;app/ae200.py&#96; - WebSocket communication with HVAC controllers
+ - &#96;app/hubitat.py&#96; - REST API calls to Hubitat hub
+ 
+ ### Configuration
+ 
+ - Configuration via YAML file (location: &#96;TEMPERATURE_BOT_CONFIG&#96; env var or &#96;temperature-bot-config.yaml&#96;)
+ - Secrets stored in YAML or environment variables (env var takes precedence)
+ - See &#96;app/util.py::get_config()&#96; and &#96;get_secret()&#96;
+ 
+ ## API Endpoints
+ 
+ ### REST API (&#96;/api/v1/*&#96;)
+ 
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/status&#96; - Current device status
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/temperature?device_ids=1,2&amp;start=&lt;unix&gt;&amp;end=&lt;unix&gt;&#96; - Time series data
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/air_quality&#96; - AQI time series
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/weather&#96; - Current weather + AQI
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/logs&#96; - Changelog with pagination
+ - &#96;POST /api/v1/set_fan_speed&#96; - Control fan (JSON body: &#96;{device_id, fan_speed}&#96;)
+ - &#96;POST /api/v1/set_drive&#96; - Control drive (JSON body: &#96;{device_id, drive}&#96;)
+ - &#96;GET /api/v1/disable-rules?seconds=&lt;int&gt;&#96; - Disable all rules
+ 
+ ### Web Pages
+ 
+ - &#96;/&#96; - Main dashboard with current status
+ - &#96;/chart&#96; - Temperature/AQI charting (ECharts)
+ - &#96;/rules&#96; - View rules, test execution, disable controls
+ - &#96;/logs&#96; - Change history
+ - &#96;/device_log/&lt;id&gt;&#96; - Per-device detailed log
+ 
+ ## Development Setup
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # macOS
+ make install-macos
+ 
+ # Ubuntu
+ make install-ubuntu
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ This installs: pipx, poetry, ruff, and Playwright browsers.
+ 
+ ### Local Development
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install dependencies
+ poetry install
+ 
+ # Run with live reload and simulator
+ make local-dev
+ # or manually:
+ FLASK_DEBUG=True DB_PATH=var/db/temperature-bot.db AE200_SIMULATOR=1 python run_local.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Testing
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Run full test suite with coverage
+ make pytest
+ 
+ # Run specific test file
+ poetry run pytest tests/test_db.py -v
+ 
+ # Linting
+ make pylint    # Python
+ make djlint    # HTML templates
+ make eslint    # JavaScript
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Database Management
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Fetch production database (readonly operations)
+ make fetch-dev-db
+ 
+ # Recreate dev database from schema
+ make make-dev-db
+ 
+ # Extract schema from database
+ make etc/schema.sql
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Testing Philosophy
+ 
+ **Comprehensive Coverage** (54+ tests across 15 files):
+ 
+ - Unit tests for core modules (&#96;test_db.py&#96;, &#96;test_ae200.py&#96;)
+ - Integration tests (&#96;test_endpoints.py&#96;, &#96;test_routes.py&#96;)
+ - Browser automation tests (&#96;test_browser_ux.py&#96; with Playwright)
+ - Bin tools regression tests (&#96;test_bin_tools.py&#96;)
+ 
+ **Key Testing Features**:
+ 
+ - Simulator mode for hardware-independent tests
+ - Temporary SQLite databases per test
+ - Pytest fixtures for database states
+ - GitHub Actions CI/CD compatible
+ 
+ **Project-Specific Rules** (from &#96;.cursorrules&#96;):
+ 
+ - Function-style pytest tests only (no base classes)
+ - No f-strings in logging methods
+ - Local fixtures preferred over conftest.py dependencies
+ 
+ ## Deployment
+ 
+ **Production Environment**:
+ 
+ - Ubuntu server with systemd
+ - Service: &#96;air_basistech_net.service&#96;
+ - Gunicorn with auto-worker scaling
+ - Database: &#96;/var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;
+ - Runs behind nginx reverse proxy
+ 
+ **Cron Job** (every minute):
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ */1 * * * * /path/to/.venv/bin/python -m bin.runner
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Rules Engine Deep Dive
+ 
+ **How Rules Work**:
+ 
+ 1. &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; is plain Python with special globals injected
+ 2. Available variables: device IDs (e.g., &#96;ERV_KITCHEN&#96;), time vars (&#96;HOUR&#96;, &#96;TUESDAY&#96;), &#96;AQI&#96;
+ 3. Available functions: &#96;set_drive(device_id, 0|1)&#96;, &#96;set_fan_speed(device_id, 1-4)&#96;
+ 4. Rules file is &#96;exec()&#96;ed with controlled namespace
+ 5. Before executing commands, checks if device/global rules disabled
+ 
+ **Example Rule**:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # Tuesday/Thursday lunch rush - high ventilation
+ if TUESDAY or THURSDAY:
+     if HOUR in [11, 12]:
+         kitchen_erv_speed = 4
+ 
+ # Poor outdoor air - reduce fresh air intake
+ if AQI &gt; 100:
+     kitchen_erv_speed = 0
+     set_drive(ERV_KITCHEN, 0)  # Turn off
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Testing Rules**:
+ 
+ - &#96;/rules&#96; page shows rule preview for next 7 days across AQI thresholds
+ - &#96;runner.py --rules test&#96; - Test rules without execution
+ - &#96;rules_engine.rules_results()&#96; - Dry-run function
+ 
+ ## Common Tasks
+ 
+ ### Adding a New Device
+ 
+ 1. Add device to Hubitat or AE-200 controller
+ 2. Device auto-registers on first data collection
+ 3. Update &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; if automation needed
+ 4. Device ID constant appears in rules engine context
+ 
+ ### Modifying Rules
+ 
+ 1. Edit &#96;bin/rules.py&#96;
+ 2. Test with &#96;/rules&#96; page or &#96;runner.py --rules test&#96;
+ 3. Deploy (no app restart needed - rules re-read each execution)
+ 
+ ### Investigating Issues
+ 
+ 1. Check logs: systemd journal or syslog
+ 2. Database query: &#96;sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;
+ 3. Web interface &#96;/logs&#96; for change history
+ 4. Per-device log: &#96;/device_log/&lt;device_id&gt;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Adding API Endpoint
+ 
+ 1. Add route to &#96;routes_api.py&#96; or &#96;routes_web.py&#96;
+ 2. Use &#96;@with_db_connection&#96; decorator for automatic DB connection
+ 3. Use Pydantic models for request validation (&#96;flask_pydantic&#96;)
+ 4. Add corresponding test in &#96;tests/test_endpoints.py&#96;
+ 
+ ## Important Gotchas
+ 
+ 1. **Temperature stored as integers**: &#96;temp10x&#96; is Celsius * 10
+ 2. **Run-length encoding**: Queries must account for &#96;logtime + duration&#96;
+ 3. **Rules disable mechanism**: Manual control disables rules for 3 hours (&#96;RULES_DISABLE_SECONDS&#96;)
+ 4. **Simulator mode**: Always check &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR&#96; env var for tests
+ 5. **Async wrappers**: AE-200 uses async, wrapped for sync contexts
+ 6. **Config precedence**: Environment variables override YAML config
+ 7. **No pytest classes**: Project uses function-style tests only
+ 
+ ## Security Considerations
+ 
+ - Secrets via environment variables or config YAML (not committed)
+ - No authentication on web interface (internal network only)
+ - SQL injection protected (parameterized queries throughout)
+ - Rules engine uses controlled &#96;exec()&#96; namespace (no file system access)
+ 
+ ## Performance Characteristics
+ 
+ - Database size: Run-length encoding keeps it manageable (months of data in MB)
+ - Runner execution: ~2-5 seconds per cycle
+ - API response times: &lt;100ms for most endpoints
+ - Chart queries: Temporal quantification for large date ranges
+ 
+ ## Future Considerations
+ 
+ - AQI storage in database (mentioned in TODO.md)
+ - Potential migration from SQLite to TimescaleDB for better time-series performance
+ - OAuth/authentication for web interface
+ - Mobile app or notifications
+ - Weather data correlation with temperature patterns
+ 
+ ## Resources
+ 
+ - AE-200 Documentation: &#96;doc/AE-200.pdf&#96;
+ - Airthings API: &#96;doc/airthings.md&#96;
+ - Release Notes: &#96;doc/RELEASE_NOTES.md&#96;
+ - Bin Tools Testing: &#96;tests/README_bin_tools.md&#96;
+ - Sample data: &#96;etc/data/*.json&#96;, &#96;app/test_data/*.json&#96;
+ 
+ ## Getting Help
+ 
+ - Codebase uses type hints extensively (mypy checked)
+ - Docstrings on most functions
+ - Test files serve as usage examples
+ - Inline comments for complex logic (especially in &#96;db.py&#96; and &#96;rules_engine.py&#96;)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ **Next Steps**: Set up local development environment, run test suite, explore &#96;/rules&#96; page, and review &#96;bin/rules.py&#96; to understand business logic.

+ # Code Review Document for Temperature Bot
+ 
+ ## Executive Summary
+ 
+ This code review evaluates the Temperature Bot project's current state across multiple dimensions. The codebase demonstrates solid engineering practices with innovative solutions for HVAC automation, though there are opportunities for improvement in several areas.
+ 
+ **Overall Assessment**: **B+** - Well-architected system with good practices, but has some technical debt and modernization opportunities.
+ 
+ ## 1. Code Quality &amp; Style
+ 
+ ### Strengths ✅
+ 
+ **Type Hints &amp; Documentation**
+ - Extensive use of type hints throughout the codebase
+ - Good docstring coverage on most functions
+ - Clear parameter and return type annotations
+ - Pydantic models for API validation (&#96;SpeedControl&#96;, &#96;DriveControl&#96;)
+ 
+ **Code Organization**
+ - Clean separation between modules (&#96;db.py&#96;, &#96;ae200.py&#96;, &#96;hubitat.py&#96;)
+ - Consistent naming conventions
+ - Logical file structure with clear responsibilities
+ 
+ **Linting &amp; Formatting**
+ - Comprehensive linting setup with Ruff, pylint, mypy
+ - Automated formatting with consistent style
+ - Good configuration in &#96;pyproject.toml&#96;
+ 
+ ### Areas for Improvement ⚠️
+ 
+ **Type Safety Issues**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # In db.py - Line 244: Missing return type annotation
+ def insert_devlog_entry(conn, *, device_id=None, device_name: str | None = None, ...):
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Inconsistent Error Handling**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # Some functions raise generic exceptions
+ except Exception as e:      # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
+     logger.error("Exception in get_aqi: %s", e)
+     return {"error": str(e)}
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Magic Numbers**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # Constants should be defined at module level
+ temp10x = int(math.floor(float(temp)*10+0.5))  # Line 259 in db.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Recommendations
+ 
+ 1. **Add missing type annotations** to all public functions
+ 2. **Define module-level constants** for magic numbers (e.g., &#96;TEMP_MULTIPLIER = 10&#96;)
+ 3. **Standardize error handling** patterns across modules
+ 4. **Consider using Result types** for better error propagation
+ 
+ ## 2. Architecture &amp; Design
+ 
+ ### Strengths ✅
+ 
+ **Innovative Design Patterns**
+ 
+ **Run-Length Encoding Implementation**
+ - Brilliant solution for time-series data compression
+ - Reduces database size dramatically while maintaining query performance
+ - Well-implemented with proper edge case handling
+ 
+ **Simulator Pattern**
+ - Excellent abstraction for hardware-independent development
+ - Critical for CI/CD and testing
+ - Clean separation between real and simulated hardware
+ 
+ **Async/Sync Hybrid**
+ - Sophisticated handling of async WebSocket operations in sync contexts
+ - &#96;AsyncRunner&#96; class properly manages event loops
+ 
+ **Modular Architecture**
+ - Clear separation of concerns (web routes, database, hardware interfaces)
+ - Dependency injection patterns with decorators (&#96;@with_db_connection&#96;)
+ - Flask blueprints for API organization
+ 
+ ### Areas for Improvement ⚠️
+ 
+ **Tight Coupling**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # db.py directly imports ae200, creating circular dependencies
+ from . import ae200
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Configuration Management**
+ - Configuration scattered across multiple files
+ - No validation of configuration values at startup
+ - Secrets management could be more robust
+ 
+ **Error Recovery**
+ - Limited retry logic for external API calls
+ - No circuit breaker patterns for hardware communication
+ 
+ ### Recommendations
+ 
+ 1. **Implement dependency injection** to reduce coupling
+ 2. **Add configuration validation** with Pydantic settings
+ 3. **Implement retry logic** with exponential backoff for external APIs
+ 4. **Consider event-driven architecture** for better decoupling
+ 
+ ## 3. Security &amp; Safety
+ 
+ ### Strengths ✅
+ 
+ **SQL Injection Prevention**
+ - Consistent use of parameterized queries throughout
+ - No string concatenation in SQL statements
+ - Proper use of SQLite3's built-in protections
+ 
+ **Input Validation**
+ - Pydantic models for API request validation
+ - Type checking on all user inputs
+ - Proper error responses for invalid requests
+ 
+ ### Areas for Improvement ⚠️
+ 
+ **Rules Engine Security**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;python
+ # High-risk: exec() with dynamic code execution
+ exec(get_rules(), v1, v2)   # pylint: disable=exec-used
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Authentication &amp; Authorization**
+ - No authentication on web interface
+ - No rate limiting on API endpoints
+ - No CSRF protection
+ 
+ **Secrets Management**

+ # Development and Production Environments Guide
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This document provides comprehensive guidance for setting up, configuring, and deploying the Temperature Bot system across different environments. It covers hardware dependencies, software requirements, configuration management, and operational procedures.
+ 
+ ## Environment Overview
+ 
+ ### Development Environment
+ 
+ **Characteristics:**
+ - Runs on developer's local machine (macOS/Ubuntu)
+ - Uses simulator mode for hardware-independent development
+ - Local SQLite database for testing
+ - Live-reload Flask development server
+ - No external hardware dependencies required
+ 
+ **Key Features:**
+ - Hardware simulation via &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR&#96; environment variable
+ - Test data from &#96;app/test_data/&#96; directory
+ - Local configuration override capabilities
+ - Full debugging and logging capabilities
+ 
+ ### Production Environment
+ 
+ **Characteristics:**
+ - Ubuntu server with systemd service management
+ - Real hardware integration (AE-200 controllers, Hubitat hub)
+ - Production SQLite database at &#96;/var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;
+ - Gunicorn WSGI server behind nginx reverse proxy
+ - Automated data collection every minute via cron
+ 
+ **Infrastructure:**
+ - Single-server deployment
+ - Network connectivity to HVAC controllers and IoT hub
+ - External API access for weather and air quality data
+ - Persistent storage for time-series database
+ 
+ ## Configuration Management
+ 
+ ### Configuration File Structure
+ 
+ **Primary Configuration:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ temperature-bot-config.yaml (or custom path via TEMPERATURE_BOT_CONFIG)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Configuration Hierarchy (precedence):**
+ 1. Environment variables (highest priority)
+ 2. YAML configuration file
+ 3. Default values in code (lowest priority)
+ 
+ ### Configuration Sections
+ 
+ **Location Settings:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml
+ location:
+   latitude: 42.3601
+   longitude: -71.0589
+   zipcode: "02108"
+   city: "boston"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Hardware Integration:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml
+ ae200:
+   host: "192.168.1.100"
+ 
+ hubitat:
+   host: "192.168.1.101"
+   appId: "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Secrets Management:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml
+ secrets:
+   hubitat:
+     access_token: "your-hubitat-token"
+   airnow:
+     api_key: "your-airnow-key"
+   google:
+     air_quality_api_key: "your-google-key"
+   aqicn:
+     token: "your-aqicn-token"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Environment Variable Overrides
+ 
+ **Secret Environment Variables:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ export HUBITAT_ACCESS_TOKEN="production-token"
+ export AIRNOW_API_KEY="production-key"
+ export GOOGLE_AIR_QUALITY_API_KEY="production-key"
+ export AQICN_TOKEN="production-token"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Configuration Environment Variables:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ export TEMPERATURE_BOT_CONFIG="/path/to/config.yaml"
+ export DB_PATH="/var/db/temperature-bot.db"
+ export AE200_SIMULATOR="1"  # For development
+ export LOG_LEVEL="DEBUG"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Hardware Dependencies
+ 
+ ### Production Hardware Requirements
+ 
+ **AE-200 HVAC Controllers:**
+ - **Model:** AE-200 Energy Recovery Ventilator Controller
+ - **Network:** Ethernet connection to local network
+ - **Protocol:** WebSocket communication on port 80
+ - **Functionality:** Controls fan speed (1-4) and drive (ON/OFF)
+ - **Expected Devices:** Kitchen ERV, Restrooms ERV (based on rules)
+ 
+ **Hubitat Hub:**
+ - **Model:** Hubitat Elevation Hub
+ - **Network:** Ethernet connection to local network
+ - **Protocol:** REST API on port 80
+ - **Functionality:** Temperature sensor data collection
+ - **Expected Devices:** Multiple temperature sensors throughout facility
+ 
+ **Network Topology:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ Internet
+     |
+     v
+ [Router/Firewall]
+     |
+     +-- [AE-200 Controller] (192.168.1.100)
+     +-- [Hubitat Hub] (192.168.1.101)
+     +-- [Temperature Bot Server] (192.168.1.102)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Development Hardware Simulation
+ 
+ **AE-200 Simulator:**
+ - Uses test data from &#96;app/test_data/ae200_*.json&#96;
+ - Simulates device discovery and status queries
+ - No network connectivity required
+ - Enable with &#96;AE200_SIMULATOR=1&#96;
+ 
+ **Hubitat Simulation:**
+ - Uses sample data from &#96;etc/data/sample_hubitat.json&#96;
+ - Simulates temperature sensor readings
+ - No actual IoT hub required for development
+ 
+ ## Software Dependencies
+ 
+ ### Python Environment
+ 
+ **Version Requirements:**
+ - Python 3.12+ (specified in &#96;pyproject.toml&#96;)
+ - Poetry for dependency management
+ - Virtual environment in &#96;.venv/&#96; directory
+ 
+ **Core Dependencies:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;toml
+ # From pyproject.toml
+ dependencies = [
+     "flask",
+     "gunicorn",
+     "requests",
+     "websockets",
+     "pymodbus",
+     "clickhouse-connect",
+     "python-dotenv",
+     "pyyaml",
+     "jinja2",
+     # ... additional dependencies
+ ]
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### External API Dependencies
+ 
+ **Air Quality APIs:**
+ - **aqicn.org:** Primary AQI data source
+ - **airnowapi.org:** Backup AQI source
+ - **Google Air Quality API:** Alternative AQI provider
+ 
+ **Weather APIs:**
+ - **US National Weather Service:** Free weather data
+ - **Required:** Latitude/longitude coordinates
+ 
+ **Network Requirements:**
+ - HTTPS access to external APIs
+ - DNS resolution for external domains
+ - No firewall restrictions on outbound HTTPS
+ 
+ ### Database
+ 
+ **SQLite Database:**
+ - **Development:** &#96;var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96; (local)
+ - **Production:** &#96;/var/db/temperature-bot.db&#96;
+ - **Schema:** Defined in &#96;etc/schema.sql&#96;
+ - **Backup:** Manual SQLite dump or rsync
+ 
+ ### Web Server
+ 
+ **Production Stack:**
+ - **Gunicorn:** WSGI application server
+ - **nginx:** Reverse proxy and static file serving
+ - **systemd:** Service management
+ 
+ **Development:**
+ - **Flask dev server:** With live-reload
+ - **livereload:** File watching for development
+ 
+ ## Build &amp; Deployment Steps
+ 
+ ### Local Development Setup
+ 
+ **1. Prerequisites Installation:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # macOS
+ make install-macos
+ 
+ # Ubuntu
+ make install-ubuntu
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **2. Environment Setup:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Clone repository
+ git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;
+ cd temperature-bot
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ poetry install
+ 
+ # Create development database
+ make make-dev-db
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **3. Configuration:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Create local config file
+ cp temperature-bot-config-example.yaml temperature-bot-config.yaml
+ 
+ # Edit configuration with local settings
+ # Set AE200_SIMULATOR=1 for hardware simulation
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **4. Start Development Server:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Run with live reload
+ make local-dev
+ 
+ # Or manually:
+ FLASK_DEBUG=True DB_PATH=var/db/temperature-bot.db AE200_SIMULATOR=1 python run_local.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Production Deployment
+ 
+ **1. Server Setup:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install system dependencies (Ubuntu)
+ sudo apt update
+ sudo apt install python3-pip pipx nginx sqlite3
+ 
+ # Install Python tools
+ make install-ubuntu
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **2. Application Deployment:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Clone to production location
+ sudo git clone &lt;repository-url&gt; /home/air/temperature-bot
+ cd /home/air/temperature-bot
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ poetry install
+ 
+ # Create production database
+ sudo mkdir -p /var/db
+ sudo sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db &lt; etc/schema.sql
+ sudo chown air:air /var/db/temperature-bot.db
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **3. Configuration:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Create production config
+ sudo cp temperature-bot-config-example.yaml /etc/temperature-bot-config.yaml
+ sudo chown air:air /etc/temperature-bot-config.yaml
+ 
+ # Edit with production settings
+ sudo nano /etc/temperature-bot-config.yaml
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **4. Service Configuration:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install systemd service
+ sudo cp etc/air_basistech_net.service /etc/systemd/system/
+ sudo systemctl daemon-reload
+ sudo systemctl enable air_basistech_net.service
+ sudo systemctl start air_basistech_net.service
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **5. Cron Job Setup:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Add to crontab for user 'air'
+ sudo crontab -u air -e
+ 
+ # Add this line for every-minute data collection:
+ * * * * * /home/air/temperature-bot/.venv/bin/python -m bin.runner
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### nginx Configuration
+ 
+ **Reverse Proxy Setup:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;nginx
+ server {
+     listen 80;
+     server_name air.basistech.net;
+ 
+     location / {
+         proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8100;
+         proxy_set_header Host $host;
+         proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
+         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
+         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
+     }
+ 
+     location /static/ {
+         alias /home/air/temperature-bot/app/static/;
+         expires 1y;
+         add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
+     }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Testing Strategies
+ 
+ ### Local Testing Without Hardware
+ 
+ **Simulator Mode:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Enable simulator for all components
+ export AE200_SIMULATOR=1
+ export PYTEST=1
+ 
+ # Run tests
+ make pytest
+

+ "
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Test Database:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Create isolated test database
+ export TEST_DB_NAME=/tmp/test.db
+ python -m pytest tests/test_db.py -v
+ 
+ # Test with sample data
+ python -m pytest tests/test_ae200.py -v

+ 
+ ### Component Testing
+ 
+ **Database Operations:**

+ "
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### CI/CD Testing
+ 
+ **GitHub Actions Compatible:**
+ - All tests run without external dependencies
+ - Simulator mode enabled automatically
+ - No hardware access required
+ - Fast execution (~6 seconds for full suite)
+ 
+ **Test Categories:**
+ - **Unit Tests:** Individual module testing
+ - **Integration Tests:** API and database integration
+ - **Browser Tests:** UI testing with Playwright
+ - **Bin Tools Tests:** Command-line tool testing
+ 
+ ## Troubleshooting &amp; Operations
+ 
+ ### Log Locations
+ 
+ **Application Logs:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash

+ sudo journalctl -u air_basistech_net.service -f
+ 
+ # Application logs (if configured)

+ 
+ **Database Inspection:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash

+ 
+ # Check recent data
+ SELECT * FROM devlog ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 10;
+ 
+ # Check device status
+ SELECT * FROM devices;
+ 
+ # Check AQI data
+ SELECT * FROM aqi ORDER BY logtime DESC LIMIT 5;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Common Issues
+ 
+ **Service Won't Start:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check service status
+ sudo systemctl status air_basistech_net.service
+ 
+ # Check configuration
+ python -c "from app.util import get_config; print(get_config())"
+ 
+ # Check database permissions

+ 
+ **Hardware Communication Issues:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash

+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Service Management
+ 
+ **Service Control:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash

+ sudo systemctl start air_basistech_net.service
+ sudo systemctl stop air_basistech_net.service

+ **Backup Strategy:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Daily backup script
+ #!/bin/bash
+ BACKUP_DIR="/backup/temperature-bot"
+ DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
+ sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db ".backup $BACKUP_DIR/temperature-bot-$DATE.db"
+ 
+ # Keep only last 30 days
+ find $BACKUP_DIR -name "temperature-bot-*.db" -mtime +30 -delete
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Security Considerations
+ 
+ ### Production Security
+ 
+ **Network Security:**
+ - Firewall rules to restrict access
+ - VPN access for remote administration
+ - No external port exposure except through nginx
+ 
+ **Application Security:**
+ - No authentication on web interface (internal network only)
+ - Secrets via environment variables
+ - Regular security updates
+ 
+ **Data Security:**
+ - Database file permissions (600)
+ - Regular backups
+ - No sensitive data in logs
+ 
+ ### Development Security
+ 
+ **Local Development:**
+ - Use simulator mode to avoid exposing real hardware
+ - Test data only (no production secrets)
+ - Local firewall if needed
+ 
+ ## Monitoring &amp; Alerting
+ 
+ ### Health Checks
+ 
+ **Service Health:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check if service is running
+ curl -f http://localhost:8100/health || echo "Service down"
+ 
+ # Check database connectivity
+ python -c "from app import db; conn = db.get_db_connection(); conn.close(); print('DB OK')"
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Data Collection Health:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check recent data collection
+ sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db "
+ SELECT 
+   datetime(logtime, 'unixepoch') as last_update,
+   COUNT(*) as recent_records
+ FROM devlog 
+ WHERE logtime &gt; strftime('%s', 'now', '-5 minutes')
+ GROUP BY device_id;
+ "
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Alerting Setup
+ 
+ **Simple Health Check Script:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ #!/bin/bash
+ # /usr/local/bin/temperature-bot-health-check.sh
+ 
+ # Check service
+ if ! systemctl is-active --quiet air_basistech_net.service; then
+     echo "Temperature Bot service is down" | mail -s "Alert" admin@basistech.com
+ fi
+ 
+ # Check recent data
+ RECENT_COUNT=$(sqlite3 /var/db/temperature-bot.db "
+ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devlog 
+ WHERE logtime &gt; strftime('%s', 'now', '-10 minutes')
+ ")
+ 
+ if [ "$RECENT_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
+     echo "No recent temperature data" | mail -s "Alert" admin@basistech.com
+ fi
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+
